name: dumbbell_census220_readout_sets
note: The dumbbell census input set (220 views, the order of inputs/input_sets/dumbbell_census220.json, every field of every unit unchanged) with a readout_set per unit: 0 = the 56 training views, 1 = the 164 held-out views (56 of views-v1 at azimuths 30, 90, ..., 330, and 108 new views 15 degrees away from the training views). Source: the `heldout` flags of runs/ex330_1120/jobs/census_meta.json (sha256 of the 164 held-out ids sorted and joined by newlines: 0ed597b43b1bfee449e3c325c4e33e84603e6271690036a303850f9042506985). `dsrl readout --sets 1` reads out the held-out views only; `decode run --units` takes any subset.
